## 1. About / Mission

Verge AI is on a mission to make advanced AI capabilities private, secure, and real-time — by running them at the edge. From enterprise operations to everyday life at home, they build intelligent systems that respect your data and deliver when milliseconds matter.

**Core Principles**:
- **100% Private**: All inference runs on-device. No cloud, no leaks, full compliance with PIPL, MLPS 2.0, and EU AI Act.
- **Real-Time Edge**: Millisecond decision-making at the source. No round-trips to distant clouds, no latency compromises.
- **Shared Intelligence**: Hub + Satellite architecture. A shared intelligence layer that makes every device smarter over time.

**Tagline**: "What happens at home, stays at home."

## 2. Products

### 2.1 VergeOps AI Appliance (B2B Enterprise)

Turnkey private AI for enterprise IT operations — purpose-built, air-gapped, and deployment-ready.

**Use Cases**:

#### Root Cause Analysis
Reads logs, SLA metrics, and historical tickets to pinpoint failures in seconds. Auto-generates remediation scripts or restart commands.
- Metric: 8-minute threat-to-report cycle

#### Smart Ticketing
Multi-format OCR for invoices, POs, and inspection forms. Natural language ticket creation with auto-SOP resolution in 3 seconds.
- Metric: Error rate -70%

#### SLA Guardian
Proactive resource bottleneck prediction. Auto-suggests scaling or failover. Ensures 99.99% high availability.
- Metric: 480x faster than manual

#### Security Autonomous Defense
8 digital avatars covering anomaly login detection, suspicious account lockdown, infected endpoint isolation, and ISO 27001 auto-reporting.
- Metric: 98% faster response

### 2.2 Edge AI Home Series (B2C Consumer)

A Hub + Satellite ecosystem where one central Home Hub powers an entire family of edge-native agents — all running 100% on-device, with zero cloud dependency.

#### Edge AI Home Hub
The Central Nervous System of Your Smart Home. Edge SLM compute + NAS + transparent holographic display.
- **Display**: 17" transparent OLED, 1920×1080, dual-sided, 2000:1 contrast
- **Dimensions**: 420×280×25mm (ultra-slim)
- **AI Compute**: RK3588 (6 TOPS NPU) + optional NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX (100 TOPS)
- **SLM Inference**: Qwen3-2B/4B W8A8 @ NPU (11.5 t/s), Qwen3-8B W4A16 @ CPU (~8 t/s)
- **Storage (NAS)**: NVMe SSD 512GB / 1TB / 2TB, AES-256 + TPM encryption
- **Memory**: 16GB–32GB LPDDR4x
- **Connectivity**: WiFi 6 + BLE 5.3 + Zigbee 3.0 (smart home hub) + 2× USB-C + HDMI 2.1
- **Satellite Protocol**: WebSocket Agent Protocol, encrypted local-only, zero-config pairing
- **Speech**: SenseVoice Small @ NPU (~150ms) — Cantonese + Mandarin + English; CosyVoice @ CPU (~300ms)
- **Sensors**: mmWave presence radar (60GHz), ambient light, temperature, humidity
- **Audio**: Omnidirectional far-field mic array (6-mic) + front-firing stereo speakers
- **Power**: 12V/3A DC, idle 5W, active 25W, max 65W (with Jetson module)
- **Cloud Fallback**: DeepSeek V4-Flash / Qwen3.6-Plus (optional)
- **Design Philosophy**: Offline First, Invisible Interface, Unified Data, Privacy by Design

#### AI Smart Mirror
Personal Beauty & Health Concierge — Real-time Visual AI analysis with 100% edge-local privacy.
- **Display**: 12"–15" semi-transparent mirror display, 4:3 aspect ratio, ≤15mm ultra-slim
- **Camera System**: Dual cameras — main RGB (AF, portrait analysis) + 120° wide-angle (full-body, hairstyle)
- **Lighting**: Adjustable color-temperature LED Ring
- **AI SoC**: RK3588 (6 TOPS NPU) + ESP32-S3 (always-on sensor hub)
- **SLM Inference**: Qwen3-2B W8A8 @ NPU (11.5 t/s)
- **Computer Vision**: MediaPipe + OpenCV + RetinaFace @ NPU — facial landmarks, skin analysis
- **AR Rendering**: Mali-G610 GPU (Vulkan 1.2) — real-time makeup overlay
- **Speech**: SenseVoice Small @ NPU (~150ms) — Cantonese + Mandarin; CosyVoice / MeloTTS @ CPU (~300ms)
- **Privacy**: Physical mechanical privacy shutter + local RAM buffer + red LED indicator
- **Colors**: Rose Gold, Matte White (Nordic), Space Gray
- **Materials**: Anodized aluminum frame, tempered glass surface
- **Use Cases**: Morning Health Quick-Check, Real-Time Makeup Guidance, Virtual Makeup Try-On, 7-Day Trend Analysis
- **Design Philosophy**: See Yourself Differently, Privacy as Luxury, Zero-Learn, Daily Ritual

#### AI Kitchen Agent
Intelligent Sous-Chef — Deep reasoning + visual perception for the modern kitchen.
- **Display**: 7"–10" IPS touchscreen, 1280×800, anti-fingerprint coating
- **Camera System**: Dual cameras — 12MP RGB (main food scan) + 5MP NIR (freshness analysis), adjustable dual-joint arm
- **AI Compute**: RK3588 (6 TOPS NPU) for standalone OR ESP32-S3 (satellite to Home Hub)
- **SLM Inference**: Qwen3-2B W8A8 @ NPU (11.5 t/s) — recipe reasoning, step-by-step navigation
- **Computer Vision**: OpenCV + custom food recognition model @ NPU — 600+ ingredient types
- **NIR Sensor**: 730–1100nm spectral — freshness, ripeness, sugar content estimation
- **Speech**: SenseVoice Small @ NPU (~150ms); CosyVoice @ CPU (~300ms)
- **Ingredient Database**: 600+ ingredients, 10,000+ recipes — local SQLite
- **Nutrition Accuracy**: ±5% for known ingredients, ±15% for novel foods
- **Audio**: Far-field mic array (4-mic) + front speaker (3W)
- **Connectivity**: WiFi 6 + BLE 5.3 + WebSocket Agent Protocol
- **Privacy**: Physical mechanical privacy shutter + red LED indicator
- **Use Cases**: Zero-Waste Mode, Multi-Timer Orchestration, Visual Calorie Estimation, Smart Grocery & Price Comparison
- **Design Philosophy**: Zero-Waste, Hands-Free, Nutrition Intelligence, Always Ready

#### AI Study Buddy
Personal AI Tutor — Long-term memory meets emotional intelligence in a desktop companion.
- **Display**: 6"–8" touchscreen, anti-glare, rounded edges
- **Form Factor**: Desktop, round soft-rubber bumper (child-safe), adjustable angle stand
- **Colors**: Vibrant Blue / Mint Green / Sunshine Yellow
- **Weight**: ~300–500g
- **Battery**: Built-in lithium, 8h+ battery life
- **AI SoC**: RK3588 (6 TOPS NPU) + ESP32-S3 (standalone); ESP32-S3 only (satellite to Home Hub)
- **SLM Inference**: Qwen3-2B W8A8 @ RK3588 NPU (11.5 t/s)
- **Emotion Sensing**: OpenCV + Audio Sentiment — expression + voice tone analysis
- **Speech**: SenseVoice Small @ NPU (~150ms) — Cantonese + Mandarin; CosyVoice @ CPU (~300ms)
- **Memory Storage**: SQLite (local) + Hub Sync — full learning history + error graph
- **Safety Design**: No sharp edges, no camera streaming, anti-glare screen
- **Cloud Fallback**: DeepSeek V4-Flash / Qwen3.6-Plus (optional)
- **Use Cases**: Long-Term Memory Tutor, Emotion-Aware Learning, Smart Error Notebook, Weekly Progress Report
- **Design Philosophy**: Companion, Scaffolding, Positive Reinforcement, Parent Partnership

#### AI Pet Buddy
Pet Wellness Guardian — Edge-based animal behavior AI with 24/7 health tracking.
- **Camera**: 4K RGB (SONY IMX678) + starlight CMOS, 2-axis PTZ (pan 360°, tilt 120°)
- **Night Vision**: 8× IR LED array, 940nm invisible, effective range 10m
- **AI Compute**: RK3588 (6 TOPS NPU) for standalone OR ESP32-S3 (satellite to Home Hub)
- **Computer Vision**: OpenCV + custom animal behavior model @ NPU
- **Multi-Pet Support**: Up to 5 pets — facial recognition + individual baselines
- **Alert Levels**: 3 tiers — 🟡 Mild (>1σ), 🟠 Moderate (>2σ), 🔴 Emergency (>3σ deviation)
- **Audio**: Dual microphones (voice command + howl/whine detection) + speaker
- **Connectivity**: WiFi 6 + BLE 5.3 + WebSocket Agent Protocol
- **Storage**: Local microSD (32GB) — 30-day behavior log + trend data
- **Power**: 5V/2A USB-C or battery base (6h battery)
- **Dimensions**: 120×100×150mm, ~450g
- **Use Cases**: Anomaly Behavior Alert, Gait Analysis, Remote Interactive Play, Weekly Wellness Report
- **Design Philosophy**: Watch Don't Record, Subtle Intelligence, Health First, Natural Interaction

#### AI Elderly Buddy
Emotional Companion + Fall Detection + Health Monitoring — 100% offline, all-in-one desktop guardian for seniors.
- **Form Factor**: Desktop companion, 160×140×180mm, warm white + wood-textured base
- **Display**: 4" circular LCD, 800×800, animated expression face + status info
- **Radar Sensor**: 60GHz mmWave (presence, fall detection, respiration rate, <200ms trigger)
- **Camera**: 5MP RGB, f/1.8, 80° FoV, with privacy shutter (HW)
- **AI Compute**: RK3588 (6 TOPS NPU) for standalone OR ESP32-S3 (satellite to Home Hub)
- **SLM Inference**: Qwen3-2B W8A8 @ RK3588 NPU (11.5 t/s) — empathetic dialogue
- **Language Support**: Cantonese, Mandarin, Sichuanese (ASR + TTS)
- **Health Monitoring**: rPPG (HR ±3bpm, RR ±2bpm, SpO₂ ±2%), mmWave (respiration, presence)
- **Fall Detection Accuracy**: >99% (fusion of radar + CV), <1 false alarm/month
- **Escalation**: 3-stage — voice check → family push notification → auto-dial emergency contacts
- **Lighting**: RGB breathing ring (mood indicator), warm amber LED (nightlight mode)
- **Audio**: Speaker (2W) + far-field mic array for voice pickup up to 5m
- **Connectivity**: WiFi 6 + BLE 5.3 + 4G LTE (optional, for fallback emergency calling)
- **Power**: 5V/2A USB-C, battery backup (2h, for fall detection during power outage)
- **Certifications**: FCC, CE, SRRC, BQB, MLPS 2.0 Ready
- **Use Cases**: Dual-Sensor Fall Detection, Emotional Companion with Dialect, 30-Second Health Check, Family Connection App
- **Design Philosophy**: Aging with Dignity, Double Detection, Privacy is Safety, Warm Presence

### 2.3 Verge Robotics (B2B Robotics)

Intelligent service robots for real-world environments. Purpose-built delivery and cleaning robots engineered for hospitality, healthcare, and commercial spaces — ODM from China's leading robotics manufacturers, purpose-built for global markets.

#### Verge Carry
Multi-floor autonomous delivery for restaurants, hotels, and hospitals. Smart tray, cabinet, and drawer configurations. Dynamic obstacle avoidance, voice interaction, and 24/7 autonomous operation.
- Metric: 4+ hrs battery · 50 kg payload

#### Verge Scrub
Intelligent floor scrubbing for commercial spaces — malls, offices, airports, and warehouses. SLAM-based navigation, auto-charging, multi-zone scheduling, and real-time fleet management.
- Metric: 3 hrs runtime · 2,000 m²/h coverage

---

## 3. Technology Stack

### Private LLM
70B–405B on-prem, 1B–7B on-device. Hot-swappable models. Deployed via VergeOps for enterprise clusters; embedded in Edge AI Home devices via Qwen3-2B/4B/8B quantized models.

### aiDAPTIV+
Virtual GPU memory via SSD — up to 8TB at 1/2000th the cost of HBM. Enables running large models on modest hardware by extending VRAM through NVMe SSD.

### Verge Agentic OS
3-tier multi-agent architecture: Commander (strategic reasoning) → Expert (domain-specific analysis) → Operator (tool execution). Orchestrates autonomous IT operations and home intelligence.

### METIS Platform
No-code AI designer from Dingxin. Cloud or on-prem, zero-code app creation for custom AI workflows.
